g.data-semantic-relation: merge preserved detail into the decoder
g.data-must-show: U 形右側上採樣 | 左右同尺度 feature 以橫向 skip concatenate | U-Net decoder 上採樣並拼接同尺度 encoder skip features
g.data-not-claim: skip connection 不等於每個接觸物件都會分開。
g.title: skip features 接回 decoder
